source: scripts/build-openscad-wasm.sh, round-to-nearest variant (8 MiB stack), from https://github.com/openscad/openscad at commit 98d891340e6007524e69f399162016f9b22584ff (GitHub Actions run 38078524115)

previousBuild.reason: Emscripten's default 64 KiB stack: a model that repeats a module a few dozen to a few hundred levels deep ran past it and damaged memory instead of stopping, and OpenSCAD's own recursion guard, which assumes 8 MiB on Emscripten, never fired. This build links the engine with an 8 MiB stack and changes nothing else.

knownIssues: projection() triggers CGAL assertion failure (openscad-wasm#6, CGAL#7560)
roof() triggers CGAL FPU error (openscad-wasm#5, openscad#5220)
lazy-union may produce incorrect geometry (disabled by default)
nextUpdate: When OpenSCAD's own build sets CGAL_ALWAYS_ROUND_TO_NEAREST for Emscripten, compare its snapshot with this build and move back to the official one
